content.short: Funton.ai is a GameFi platform for Telegram and LINE mini apps, tap-to-earn games, and project launch tooling.
content.description: Funton.ai is a GameFi platform for Web3 projects focused on Telegram and LINE mini apps, tap-to-earn gameplay, and launch tooling for casual games. It combines reward-driven minigames with GameFi-as-a-Service features for teams that want to publish and grow interactive experiences. Funton.ai remains a game listing because progression, play, competition, collection, and rewards are the main user activities.
